brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分一层层折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifiers layer by layer.

t.zh: 一个修饰成分里面还可以有修饰成分：of the A of the B，后一个说明前一个里的名词。从最里面那一块折起，一层层往外。
t.en: A modifier can hold modifiers of its own: in of the A of the B, the second tells about the noun in the first. Fold from the innermost piece outwards.

hint.zh: 最后一个介词短语，说明的是紧挨在它前面的那个名词吗？
hint.en: Does the last prepositional phrase tell about the noun just before it?

hint.zh: 谓语 are initialized 是复数：被初始化的是什么？
hint.en: The verb are initialized is plural: what is initialized?

sentence: The weights of the last layer of the decoder in our model are initialized randomly.

folds.span: of the decoder in our model
of the last layer of the decoder in our model

the last layer.zh: layer 是单数，谓语却是 are。被初始化的是权重：of the last layer 说明是哪一层的权重。
the last layer.en: layer is singular, but the verb is are. What is initialized is the weights: of the last layer says which layer’s.

title.zh: The weights of the last layer of the decoder in our model are initialized randomly.
title.en: The weights of the last layer of the decoder in our model are initialized randomly.

body.zh: 三层折完，主干是 The weights are initialized randomly：我们模型里解码器最后一层的权重是随机初始化的。一串介词短语里，每一个通常说明紧挨在它前面的名词。
body.en: Three layers folded, the skeleton is The weights are initialized randomly: the weights of the last layer of the decoder in our model start at random. In a chain of prepositional phrases, each usually tells about the noun just before it.

note.zh: 从里往外折：每一块挂在它前面最近、说得通的那个名词上。
note.en: Fold from the inside out: each piece on the nearest noun before it that makes sense.
